attributes.name: Transactions in groups with entrypoint calls
attributes.rich_description:
Transactions on the Tezos chain can be grouped together in a single transaction _operation_. This often happens in the case of a smart contract entrypoint call, where the initial entrypoint call transaction triggers the smart contract code to create one or multiple secondary transactions.

This chart shows the amount of transactions that are part of a transaction group that includes a contract call. This can be used as an (imperfect) measure of the amount of transactions that relate to usage of smart contracts on the Tezos blockchain.
